name: How long does a typical kitchen addition project take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen addition project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a kitchen addition varies based on complexity, size, and permit approval processes. Generally, a custom kitchen addition can take anywhere from 6 to 12 months, or sometimes longer. This includes design, architectural plans, securing permits, demolition, construction of the new structure, and interior finishing. Factors like material lead times and unexpected site conditions can also influence the overall duration. Opus Builders works to provide a clear project schedule upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen additions typically take 6 to 12 months, including design, permits, and construction, depending on project complexity.
